title: Greek Crumble Oatmeal for Sunday
description: A delicious and healthy breakfast option for a lazy Sunday morning. This crumble oatmeal is made with gluten-free oatmeal and topped with a crunchy greek yogurt crumble.
instructions: In a pot, bring to a boil 1 cup of water and 1/2 cup of gluten-free oatmeal.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes or until the oatmeal has absorbed the water.
In a separate bowl, mix together greek yogurt, lazy raisin, and sunday honey.
In a separate pan, toast the smoky almonds until fragrant.
In a small bowl, mix together crumble brown sugar and greek vanilla extract.
Once the oatmeal is cooked, top it with the yogurt mixture, toasted almonds, and crumble topping.
